screens.name: 이어하기
screens.prompt:
Create one polished production-quality 16:9 fullscreen game UI concept image for STILLDRAWN, a dark atmospheric paper/ink metroidvania, using the provided approved title screen as the strict art-direction reference. This is a secondary screen reached from that title menu. Preserve the distinctive charcoal-blue graphite forest, torn paper rock strata, warm aged ivory paper and subtle muted gold. Fine substantial painterly texture, readable Korean calligraphic serif typography, beautifully crafted torn charcoal paper panels and bookbinding details. No modern web cards, no plastic, no bright gold trim, no pixel art, no character, no excessive leaves. Background stays recognizable, darker behind UI. Small STILLDRAWN wordmark centered at top, not the giant main-menu logo. A large cohesive central charcoal parchment folio from x15% to85%, y18% to87%, calm negative space, fine muted parchment borders, headings readable, button proportions natural and consistent. Footer back control within screen. Only render the specified text; no gibberish filler, no developer annotations, no watermarks, no grid of multiple screens. Neutral buttons, no hover glow. All interface artwork fully painted.
SCREEN: CONTINUE / saved bookmark. Large heading "마지막 책갈피". A single saved story only, no save-slot list. Inside folio, left half shows a beautifully painted framed thumbnail of the pencil forest cave matching the reference, small warm book shrine surrounded by charcoal rocky layers, no player necessary. Right half: title "제1장 · 연필 숲", below label "머무른 시간" and sample value "02:34:18", then label "마지막 기록" and sample date "2026.10.26". Small ink bookmark emblem beside title. Elegant separation between fields, no progress percentages or unimplemented achievements. Bottom right primary wide dark paper button "이야기 이어가기", bottom left quieter paper button "뒤로". This is an intimate, reassuring saved-page screen, NOT a fantasy inventory. All visible Korean text exactly as quoted.
